text.description_html:
First Impressions DS-SS-2 Contemporary Short Stainless Steel Door Stop

Constructed of solid stainless steel this 2" contemporary door stop screws onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

These short door stops are suited for special applications. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

For use in residential and commercial applications. Soft Satin Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications of First Impressions DS-SS-2 2" Door Stop

  • Total Length: 2"
  • Diameter: 1/2"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • White Rubber Bumper Tip
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Note: These special short door stops are hand crafted in the USA. They can be made to other lengths for your specific application. Please Contact Us with your requirements.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
